page_title: IPS 1-4 TOT | Ipswich v Tottenham Hotspur 22/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

raw: van de Ven M. Lacking Match Fitness

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+8' Jaden Philogene (Ipswich) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Guglielmo Vicario, who smothers the ball.
90+7' Leif Davis (Ipswich) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
90+3' Omari Hutchinson (Ipswich) takes the corner.
90+3' Omari Hutchinson (Ipswich) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared. Ipswich earn a corner.
90' There will be a minimum of 8 min. of added time.

90' The game is interrupted. Luke Woolfenden (Ipswich) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. A free kick has been awarded to Tottenham.
90' Jaden Philogene (Ipswich) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
87' Ipswich force their opponents to concede a corner.
87' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Jaden Philogene (Ipswich). Good work from Ipswich as they win a corner.
85' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Lucas Bergvall departs the field of play to be replaced by Yves Bissouma (Tottenham).

84' 1 - 4 Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Alex Palmer with a precise strike which bounces off the bottom of the left post and into the back of the net. He makes it 1:4.
83' George Hirst (Ipswich) commits a foul during an attacking move. Tottenham have a free kick.
80' Kieran McKenna is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Kalvin Phillips (Ipswich) suffers an injury and Samy Morsy comes on.
79' It is time for a substitution. George Hirst (Ipswich) is on for Liam Delap.
79' The attendance for today's match is 30003.
79' The game is interrupted now, Kalvin Phillips (Ipswich) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
77' 1 - 3 Goal! Djed Spence (Tottenham) finishes from close range with an easy finish and he makes it 1:3. He was ably assisted there by James Maddison.
76' Dangerous play by Jaden Philogene (Ipswich). Tim Robinson blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick to Tottenham.
74' Ange Postecoglou has decided to substitute Heung-Min Son and he is replaced by Wilson Odobert (Tottenham).
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mathys Tel leaves the pitch and Dane Scarlett (Tottenham) comes on.
74' Tim Robinson couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) and blew his whistle. Ipswich have been awarded a free kick.

73' Jaden Philogene (Ipswich) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
72' Ipswich work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
72' Omari Hutchinson (Ipswich) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Corner kick. Ipswich will have an opportunity.
71' A decent cross into the box is met first time by Nathan Broadhead (Ipswich), but his powerful goalbound effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
69' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
68' Substitution. Nathan Broadhead (Ipswich) in, Jack Clarke out.

68' Tim Robinson blows his whistle as Liam Delap (Ipswich) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack. Tottenham win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.

68' James Maddison (Tottenham) attempts to beat the goalkeeper with an accurate shot from the free kick, which is placed dangerously close to the penalty area. However, Alex Palmer pulls off a great save to stop his attempt towards the roof of the net.
67' Omari Hutchinson (Ipswich) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Tottenham have a free kick.
66' Liam Delap (Ipswich) was too forceful with his tackle and Tim Robinson interrupted the game to signal a free kick. Tottenham win a free kick.
65' That will be all from Destiny Udogie who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Pedro Porro (Tottenham).
64' Here is a change. Brennan Johnson is going off and Ange Postecoglou gives the last tactical orders to James Maddison (Tottenham).
64' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.

62' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. Tottenham have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
61' A goal, which was scored by Luke Woolfenden (Ipswich), was disallowed due to offside.
61' The goalkeeper is not tested by the free kick from the edge of the box by Omari Hutchinson (Ipswich) as his effort only hit the wall.
59' Tim Robinson has a clear sight and sees a foul from Destiny Udogie (Tottenham). Ipswich will take a free kick near the side line.
58' The free kick is taken by Leif Davis (Ipswich), but ball is cleared.
57' The referee blows his whistle as Archie Gray (Tottenham) was too aggressive in his challenge. Ipswich are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
54' Liam Delap (Ipswich) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Tim Robinson saw the whole situation. Free kick. Tottenham will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
52' Kieran McKenna is forced to make a change. Jens Cajuste is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Jack Taylor (Ipswich).
52' Jens Cajuste (Ipswich) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
51' Djed Spence (Tottenham) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
49' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
46' Rough tackle by Dara O'Shea (Ipswich). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Tottenham.
46' Kieran McKenna has made a change at the break. Luke Woolfenden (Ipswich) has come on in place of Ben Godfrey.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' Tim Robinson has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' Liam Delap (Ipswich) makes a rough challenge and Tim Robinson blows his whistle for a foul. Tottenham have a free kick.
45+1' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
45' A crossfield pass from Djed Spence (Tottenham) fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ipswich.
45' Mathys Tel (Tottenham) is able to continue to play.
43' Mathys Tel (Tottenham) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
42' Mathys Tel (Tottenham) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
42' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) takes the corner but it's cleared.

42' Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham) takes the ball, nicely zig-zags through the defence, but his low drive to the middle of the goal is smartly dealt with by Alex Palmer. Tottenham will take a corner kick.
40' The game is interrupted. Ben Godfrey (Ipswich) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.

39' Omari Hutchinson (Ipswich) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly low towards the middle of the goal, but Guglielmo Vicario is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
36' 1 - 2 Omari Hutchinson (Ipswich) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and curls the ball inside the right post in trademark fashion.
35' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
34' A clumsy foul by Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) and Tim Robinson blows his whistle. That's a free kick to Ipswich.
32' Jack Clarke (Ipswich) is booked.
32' Leif Davis (Ipswich) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
30' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) commits a rough challenge and Tim Robinson blows his whistle for an infringement. Ipswich are awarded a free kick.
28' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) sends the corner into the box, but Alex Palmer intercepts it and averts the threat.

28' Excellent touch by Heung-Min Son (Tottenham)! He latches on to a precise pass deep into the box and unleashes a low drive towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a terrific save. The ball is out of play and Tottenham manage to earn a corner.
26' 0 - 2 Goal! Heung-Min Son plays a pass to the feet of Brennan Johnson (Tottenham), and he shoots into the bottom right corner from inside the box. It's 0:2.
25' Leif Davis (Ipswich) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
24' Liam Delap (Ipswich) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Guglielmo Vicario stops the ball from hitting the bottom left corner.
22' Jaden Philogene (Ipswich) takes the rebound on the edge of the box and fires the ball just over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Tottenham.
22' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Ipswich.

21' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Liam Delap (Ipswich). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate. The linesman makes the right call and Ipswich will have a corner.
20' Jack Clarke (Ipswich) meets an accurate cross inside the six-yard box and attempts a bullet header, but the goalkeeper denies him and makes the save.
18' 0 - 1 Goal - 0:1! Heung-Min Son laid the ball off to Brennan Johnson (Tottenham), who shot from close range low into the back of the net, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
17' Jack Clarke (Ipswich) commits a rough foul. Tim Robinson stops the game and makes a call. It's a free kick to Tottenham, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
15' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) sees a yellow card from Tim Robinson after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
13' Lucas Bergvall (Tottenham) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.

11' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Tim Robinson with no other option than to blow for a foul. Ipswich are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.

6' Liam Delap (Ipswich) wasted a great chance as he climbed high to connect with a cross from the free kick inside the penalty area. He planted a header against the left post and it glanced away off it.
6' Kevin Danso (Tottenham) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Ipswich get a free kick.
5' Kalvin Phillips (Ipswich) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Tim Robinson blows for a foul. Tottenham will take a free kick.
3' Liam Delap (Ipswich) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Tottenham will have a goal kick.
1' Omari Hutchinson (Ipswich) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
1' Liam Delap (Ipswich) receives a great pass inside the box and misses a golden chance. The goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save.
1' The first half has just begun.
Tottenham will kick the game off.
Tim Robinson got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
